create.name: Roxanne Dault
create.bio:
Roxanne Dault is an insight meditation teacher living in Montréal (Tiohtià:ke), where she is a guiding teacher with True North Insight, the bilingual Canadian sangha also called Voie boréale. Over more than twenty years of practice she has sat long silent retreats in Asia and in North America, adding up to more than two years in silence. Joseph Goldstein invited her into the four-year IMS teacher training, and she now leads retreats in Barre as well as in Quebec and France. Her roots are in the Burmese vipassana lineage of Mahasi Sayadaw.

She teaches in both French and English: a weekly francophone sangha in Montréal and on Zoom, online lovingkindness gatherings for IMS, residential retreats, and a graduate course on mindful presence at UQAM. Time in nature and Indigenous wisdom colour her teaching, and she is learning Anishinaabemowin, the language of her ancestors. Her training in Somatic Experiencing shows in the way she brings attention back to the body. Alongside group work she meets practitioners one to one for mentoring, offered on a dana basis.

courses.title: Moving Towards Freedom with Love and Wisdom Livestream Retreat 2027
courses.description: A four-night silent retreat streamed live from the IMS meditation hall in Barre, taught by Roxanne Dault and Matthew Brensilver. Periods of sitting and walking practice alternate with dharma talks, and the theme is letting care, courage and steadiness grow together with wisdom. Registration opens on 17 November 2026.

courses.title: Metta Sangha (IMS Online)
courses.description: A Tuesday evening lovingkindness group held online every other week, with a short reflection, a guided metta sitting and time for questions. Teachers take turns through the year; Roxanne Dault co-leads the December sessions.
courses.price: Free, or $10 to $15 USD per month (optional subscription)

courses.title: One-to-one Dharma Mentoring
courses.description: Individual meetings of 30 to 45 minutes, usually every month or two, to talk through your practice and the questions it raises. They are offered on a donation basis in keeping with the dana tradition.

courses.title: Francophone Sangha (Tuesday evenings, Montréal and online)
courses.description: A weekly French-language sitting group run by True North Insight, meeting in person on the Plateau in Montréal and on Zoom. Roxanne Dault is one of its regular teachers, with Pascal Auclair and others.
